events.name: Boston Bruins at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: Brad Marchand scored two goals in the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchand scored twice in 3rd, Bruins beat Maple Leafs 4-2

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: Mackenzie Blackwood made 38 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 2-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mackenzie Blackwood stops 38 shots; Devils top Penguins 2-1

headlines.description: Shea Weber scored to extend his point streak to five games, Carey Price made 25 saves and the Montreal Canadiens responded to a big hit by Alex Ovechkin on Jonathan Drouin, beating the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens respond to Ovechkin’s hit on Drouin, beat Capitals

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: Zach Werenski scored 3:34 into overtime to give the Columbus Blue Jackets a 3-2 win over the St. Louis Blues on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Werenski’s OT goal lifts Blue Jackets over Blues 3-2

headlines.description: Filip Chlapik scored in the second period, Anders Nilsson made 26 saves and the Ottawa Senators killed off a late four-minute power play to beat the Philadelphia Flyers 2-1 Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nilsson makes 26 saves as Senators beat Flyers 2-1
